videos.title: NEW Volvo EX60: Best EV SUV in the world?
videos.summary_source_text:
NEW Volvo EX60: Best EV SUV in the world? The Volvo EX60 has the BMW iX3 in its sights! But is it the better car? 

Get 20% off Car Vertical using code Carwow: https://www.carvertical.com/carwow

Volvo’s all-new mid-size SUV is here! 

The Volvo EX60 is a practical, all-electric SUV with a range of over 500 miles. The thing is, though, the BMW iX3 has already been around for a while, also runs for over 500 miles on a single charge, and will cost you less than the Volvo! 

But is the Volvo a better choice? Let’s get into it, starting with the design. 

From the outside, the Volvo EX60 is one of the best-looking cars in its class. Up front, it has the traditional Thor hammer DRLs, with the main headlights housed separately underneath these. The centre of the front end is clean and well-designed, and thankfully, hides the driving sensors - unlike many other cars! Along the side, the design is clean, and the car we have here has a black pack, which means the windows have black surrounds - the standard car comes with silver instead. The rear of the car is very similar to the EX30 - but that’s no bad thing! It looks clean and smart. 

The interior of the EX60 is seriously impressive. There are soft-touch materials throughout, and the seats are incredibly comfortable. The steering wheel comes in a design style different to any other car we’ve seen before, but the set-up makes it easy to see the digital dials. The infotainment screen is large and responsive, although it’s annoying that almost every function is housed within it. The gear selector is a stalk on the steering wheel, and there’s more than enough storage, even though there isn’t a traditional glove box. 

The entry-level EX60 is the Plus P6, which comes with a single motor driving the rear wheels and 374bhp. The car we have here is the Ultra P10, which comes with dual motors and 510hp. The range-topper is the Ultra P12, which produces 680hp and hits 60mph in 3.9 seconds. 

The entry-level EX60 costs from £56,860, while the range-topper costs £70,360. But is it the better choice than an iX3? Let us know which you’d choose in the comments!

videos.summary_source_text:
Scottie Scheffler's SENSATIONAL Sunday to win FedExCup | Round 4 | TOUR Championship | 2026 In the final round of the 2026 TOUR Championship, Scottie Scheffler shoots a 4-under 66 to win the final event of the season by three shots, achieving his 22nd PGA TOUR victory and winning the FedExCup title.

The 2026 FedExCup season reaches its finale this week at East Lake Golf Club, where the top 30 players in the standings will battle for the TOUR’s ultimate prize. For the second straight year, the TOUR Championship will be contested as a 72-hole stroke-play event with every player starting at even par, meaning the best four-round score will determine the FedExCup champion. Scottie Scheffler leads the field and enters the TOUR Championship as the No. 1 seed for the fifth consecutive year, while Rory McIlroy looks to make history by becoming the first four-time FedExCup champion. Wyndham Clark arrives at No. 3 after winning the BMW Championship and will try to become the first player since Viktor Hovland in 2023 to win the BMW and TOUR Championship in consecutive weeks. Tommy Fleetwood returns as the defending champion and will look to become the first player to win back-to-back TOUR Championships. Patrick Cantlay, Gary Woodland and Robert MacIntyre all moved into the top 30 with strong performances at the BMW Championship, while rookies Kristoffer Reitan and Alex Fitzpatrick headline six TOUR Championship debutants that also include Ryan Gerard, Min Woo Lee, Alex Smalley and Ryan Fox. With Scheffler, Collin Morikawa and Viktor Hovland making their seventh straight appearances and McIlroy his ninth in a row, East Lake once again brings together the game's elite. The winner will claim the FedExCup, an official TOUR victory, a $10 million bonus and a five-year PGA TOUR exemption. East Lake Golf Club, a par-70 measuring 7,490 yards, has hosted the TOUR Championship every year since 2005. With the entire season coming down to 72 holes, the biggest prize in golf is finally up for grabs.

videos.title: Game changer tips to Hit Your Driver Farther!
videos.summary_source_text:
Game changer tips to Hit Your Driver Farther! 👀 Want more driver distance? Don’t just swing harder. Check these 3 things first. 👇

1. Get some spine tilt away from the target at setup. That helps you hit up on the driver.
2. Keep the takeaway wide. I like creating about 10 to 12 inches of space instead of hinging the club too early.
3. Use the ground. Shift your pressure forward in the downswing, then push up through the ball.

Better setup. More width. More ground force.

That’s how you start creating speed without just trying to kill it.

videos.summary_source_text:
STOP, You're Training Your Triceps All Wrong! If you want to know how to build bigger triceps, how to get bigger triceps, or how to build big triceps that fill out your shirt sleeves, this video shows you what you may be missing. You can do tricep pushdowns, close grip bench presses, skull crushers, overhead extensions and kickbacks, but if you are not putting the long head of the triceps under tension in the right positions, your arms can still look flat from the side and lack the thickness you are after.

Fix Flat Triceps Here - http://athleanx.com/x/fix-flat-triceps
Subscribe To This Channel Here - http://bit.ly/2b0coMW

The long head is the largest head of the triceps and one of the biggest contributors to overall upper arm size. If your goal is to build bigger arms, you cannot just add more tricep exercises. You have to challenge the long head in both positions where it can work hardest: with the arm overhead in shoulder flexion to create a strong stretch, and with the arm driven back behind the body into shoulder extension to create a hard shortened-position contraction.

In this video, I break down the most common triceps training mistakes that keep people from getting bigger triceps and show you how to fix each one.

First, we look at the skull crusher. Most people lower the weight toward the forehead and think they are maximizing the stretch on the long head. The problem is that the upper arm often stays too far in front of the body. By allowing the arms to angle farther back behind the head and then keeping that upper-arm position fixed while bending and straightening the elbows, you can place much more tension on the long head of the triceps.

Next is the tricep push away. This exercise can be great for building big triceps, but only if the line of pull is right. If the arms finish too low and become almost parallel to the rope, tension drops. The fix is to finish with the arms higher so the forearms stay more perpendicular to the cable. I also show you the step-through push away, which lets you use more weight, create controlled momentum on the concentric, and then overload the eccentric while still getting a strong overhead stretch.

The third exercise is the dumbbell overhead tricep extension, or power bomb. This is one of the most popular exercises for anyone trying to get bigger triceps, but shoulder mobility and elbow position can ruin it. When the elbows flare wide, elbow range of motion gets shorter and the triceps lose tension. By setting an incline bench behind you, you can reduce the shoulder-flexion demand, keep the elbows more forward and close to the head, and still get a deep stretch on the triceps without forcing the shoulders into an uncomfortable position.

Stretch-focused tricep exercises matter, but they are not the only exercises that matter. To fully develop the long head, you also need movements that take the arm behind the body and place the triceps in a strongly shortened position.

That is where the Wolverine pulldown comes in. Because the long head crosses the shoulder joint, it also helps extend the arm behind the body. The Wolverine pulldown combines a pulling motion with elbow extension, allowing you to pull the elbows tight to the body and then drive the hands behind you for an intense contraction. This complements your overhead work and helps create more complete triceps development.

Finally, we fix the dumbbell tricep kickback. Kickbacks get criticized because they are often done badly. As fatigue sets in, the lower back rounds, the elbows drop, and the exercise becomes a weak elbow extension. The solution is to perform the kickback face down on an incline bench. The bench stabilizes your torso, removes the low-back limitation, and lets you deliberately drag the elbows behind the body before extending the dumbbells. This ensures every rep starts from the position that maximizes contraction of the long head.

If your triceps look flat, your arms do not fill your sleeves, or you feel like your triceps have stopped growing even though you train them consistently, this video will show you how to build bigger triceps by improving exercise selection, setup, range of motion, arm position and tension instead of simply doing more sets.

The biggest takeaway is simple: if you want to know how to get bigger triceps, train the long head in both a stretched position and a fully shortened position. Combine both and you give yourself a better chance to build thicker, fuller triceps.

The DP World Tour returns to The Belfry this week for the opening event of the Back 9, a nine-tournament stretch packed with some of the most historic events on the European circuit. The first ten minutes of most practices are gone before anyone notices. Laps, a whistle, some stretching at the blue line, and a group of players who are now warm but no better than when they walked in. That block is worth a lot more than it is being used for.

In this video I go through exactly how I would restructure it: where the warm-up actually belongs, how to run it so nobody is standing in a line, why every player should have a puck from the very first rep, and the two mechanics I would put ahead of everything else. Watch the full walkthrough to see how the block is built and what to run inside it.

The Downhill Skating System is the mechanics-first approach that unlocks effortless, controlled speed on the ice without extra conditioning, pushing or “trying harder.” Inspired by the movement signatures of players like Connor McDavid, Nathan MacKinnon, Cale Makar, Quinn Hughes, and other elite NHL skaters, this system teaches you how to move on the ice with gravity, using your body's own stretch shortening cycles mixed with the most efficient footwork patterns and various skating mechanics.

Most players skate “uphill”: stiff, blocky, pushing hard, creating tension and burning energy like we were always taught in traditional powerskating. Downhill skating flips that model. By using counter rotation, proper joint angles, and natural gravitational momentum, we teach you move faster with less effort.

Inside the Downhill Skating System, players learn to:

1) Unlock the inner spring for better acceleration.
2)Use different footwork patterns to add options, deception and effortlessness. 
3)Proper joint alignment for efficiency and balance instead of creating tension with push strides.

Apply NHL-base mechanics like shin angle, Y-angle, rhythm and cadence. Generate speed using the rocker, with heel pressure and subtle weight transfers.

This system is not what players would learn in traditional, outdated power skating methods. It’s a biomechanics-based operating system designed to match your body type and natural movement patterns.

Whether you’re trying to improve the forward stride, lateral movements, deception, or posture, Downhill Skating reveals the hidden mechanics the NHL’s best rely on, and shows you how to plug them into your game step by step.

Discover the big iodine mistake 50% of people are making, common iodine deficiency signs, the problem with too much iodine, and how to make sure you get just the right amount.

Low iodine and too much iodine can both affect the thyroid in the same way. You may experience the same low thyroid symptoms, such as weight gain, fatigue, eyebrow thinning, hair loss, cold hands, and cold feet.

Many people have low iodine. If you’re not regularly consuming iodine-rich foods, you could be deficient. People on plant-based diets often have very low levels of iodine.

Iodine often goes under the radar, but its benefits extend beyond the thyroid. It supports cognitive function, helps break down estradiol, and regulates estrogen receptors. Iodine deficiency has been connected to fibrocystic breasts and often improves when you increase your iodine levels. Iodine also supports the health and function of the uterus and fallopian tubes.

Too much iodine can trigger autoimmune disease, so avoiding too much is just as important as getting enough.

How much iodine do you need? Most adults need around 150–300 mcg of iodine each day, 220 mcg during pregnancy, and 290 mcg while breastfeeding.

videos.title: I Built A Tuned Japanese Kei Car For Golf GTI Money!
videos.summary_source_text:
I Built A Tuned Japanese Kei Car For Golf GTI Money! There's over £20,000 of parts and labour in this £11,000 Honda S660 — double what the car is worth. Full HKS turbo conversion, full Spoon Sports chassis package, and a dyno to find out what it was all for.

Check any car's history before you buy with carVertical: https://www.carvertical.com/gb/landing/v3?a=watson&b=38b26e3a&voucher=watson&utm_medium=infl — use code WATSON for 20% off.

The S660 is Honda's mid-engined kei sports car: 660cc, turbocharged from the factory, and claimed at 63hp because kei cars were capped there by agreement between the manufacturers. Except when we put mine on the dyno it made more than claimed. Honda, it turns out, were being modest.

So it went to Torque GT in Devon for the full HKS turbo conversion — bigger turbo, high-flow sports cat, water-cooled charge cooler, uprated fuel pump, induction kit, exhaust and ECU flash — plus a complete Spoon Sports chassis package: coilovers, four-piston big brake kit, vented discs, anti-roll bars, chassis bracing, motion control beam and SW388 forged wheels on Nankang NS-2R tyres.

HKS claim their kit is good for 100hp. We got more. Then I drove a standard S660 back to back with mine and ran the quarter mile to find out what all that hardware actually buys you.

This was also a test for my Japanese import business — I want to start bringing in sports cars alongside the Jimnys and Land Cruisers, and offering buyers these tuning parts before the car's delivered. Should I? Let me know in the comments.

videos.title: PGA TOUR Highlights | Round 3 | TOUR Championship | 2026
videos.summary_source_text:
PGA TOUR Highlights | Round 3 | TOUR Championship | 2026 Check out all the best shots from the third round of the 2026 TOUR Championship, featuring Rory McIlroy, Scottie Scheffler, Viktor Hovland and Adam Scott, among others.

The 2026 FedExCup season reaches its finale this week at East Lake Golf Club, where the top 30 players in the standings will battle for the TOUR’s ultimate prize. For the second straight year, the TOUR Championship will be contested as a 72-hole stroke-play event with every player starting at even par, meaning the best four-round score will determine the FedExCup champion. Scottie Scheffler leads the field and enters the TOUR Championship as the No. 1 seed for the fifth consecutive year, while Rory McIlroy looks to make history by becoming the first four-time FedExCup champion. Wyndham Clark arrives at No. 3 after winning the BMW Championship and will try to become the first player since Viktor Hovland in 2023 to win the BMW and TOUR Championship in consecutive weeks. Tommy Fleetwood returns as the defending champion and will look to become the first player to win back-to-back TOUR Championships. Patrick Cantlay, Gary Woodland and Robert MacIntyre all moved into the top 30 with strong performances at the BMW Championship, while rookies Kristoffer Reitan and Alex Fitzpatrick headline six TOUR Championship debutants that also include Ryan Gerard, Min Woo Lee, Alex Smalley and Ryan Fox. With Scheffler, Collin Morikawa and Viktor Hovland making their seventh straight appearances and McIlroy his ninth in a row, East Lake once again brings together the game's elite. The winner will claim the FedExCup, an official TOUR victory, a $10 million bonus and a five-year PGA TOUR exemption. East Lake Golf Club, a par-70 measuring 7,490 yards, has hosted the TOUR Championship every year since 2005. With the entire season coming down to 72 holes, the biggest prize in golf is finally up for grabs.

videos.title: Rory McIlroy SURGES on into Saturday contention | Round 3 | TOUR Champonship | 2026
videos.summary_source_text:
Rory McIlroy SURGES on into Saturday contention | Round 3 | TOUR Champonship | 2026 In the third round of the 2026 TOUR Championship, Rory McIlroy shoots a 7-under 63 to get to 10-under par overall, sitting T7 on the leaderboard heading into Sunday.

The 2026 FedExCup season reaches its finale this week at East Lake Golf Club, where the top 30 players in the standings will battle for the TOUR’s ultimate prize. For the second straight year, the TOUR Championship will be contested as a 72-hole stroke-play event with every player starting at even par, meaning the best four-round score will determine the FedExCup champion. Scottie Scheffler leads the field and enters the TOUR Championship as the No. 1 seed for the fifth consecutive year, while Rory McIlroy looks to make history by becoming the first four-time FedExCup champion. Wyndham Clark arrives at No. 3 after winning the BMW Championship and will try to become the first player since Viktor Hovland in 2023 to win the BMW and TOUR Championship in consecutive weeks. Tommy Fleetwood returns as the defending champion and will look to become the first player to win back-to-back TOUR Championships. Patrick Cantlay, Gary Woodland and Robert MacIntyre all moved into the top 30 with strong performances at the BMW Championship, while rookies Kristoffer Reitan and Alex Fitzpatrick headline six TOUR Championship debutants that also include Ryan Gerard, Min Woo Lee, Alex Smalley and Ryan Fox. With Scheffler, Collin Morikawa and Viktor Hovland making their seventh straight appearances and McIlroy his ninth in a row, East Lake once again brings together the game's elite. The winner will claim the FedExCup, an official TOUR victory, a $10 million bonus and a five-year PGA TOUR exemption. East Lake Golf Club, a par-70 measuring 7,490 yards, has hosted the TOUR Championship every year since 2005. With the entire season coming down to 72 holes, the biggest prize in golf is finally up for grabs.

videos.title: Grok 5: 10 Trillion Parameters, AGI Claims & the Truth Behind the Delay
videos.summary_source_text:
Grok 5: 10 Trillion Parameters, AGI Claims & the Truth Behind the Delay https://bitbiased.ai/ai-automation-services
Elon Musk says Grok 5 could become the smartest AI in the world — and has even suggested it has a chance of reaching human-level intelligence. But Grok 5 still hasn’t shipped.

So what has xAI actually confirmed?

In this video, we break down everything currently known about Grok 5: the reported 6–10 trillion parameter models being trained, xAI’s massive Colossus AI infrastructure, the Grok 4.5 and Grok 4.6 models that shipped instead, and how xAI currently compares with OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

We also examine Musk’s AGI claims, Grok’s reported 1.5-million-token context target, the enormous compute requirements behind the model, xAI’s synthetic-data strategy, and the networking and training challenges that could help explain why Grok 5 keeps slipping.

Beyond the parameter count, there’s an even bigger story: Musk is attempting to connect Grok with X, Tesla, Optimus, SpaceX, and potentially future orbital compute infrastructure. If that ecosystem works, xAI’s biggest advantage may not be model size at all — it could be access to data, compute, and distribution that other AI companies can’t easily replicate.

But until Grok 5 actually ships with independently verifiable benchmarks, the gap between what’s promised and what’s proven remains significant.

Watch the full breakdown for what’s confirmed, what remains speculation, and what Grok 5 will actually need to prove when it finally launches.

Subscribe for evidence-based coverage of AI models, xAI, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, and the rapidly changing race toward frontier AI.

videos.title: Gemini Transcribe Explained: Is It Really 99% Accurate?
videos.summary_source_text:
Gemini Transcribe Explained: Is It Really 99% Accurate? https://bitbiased.ai/ai-automation-services
Google’s new Gemini 3.5 Transcribe is being called a 99% accurate AI transcription model — but is it actually that accurate?

I dug into Google’s numbers, independent transcription benchmarks, pricing, latency, and the competition to find out how Gemini 3.5 Transcribe really compares with ElevenLabs Scribe, Microsoft Azure, OpenAI GPT-4o Transcribe, AssemblyAI, Deepgram, Amazon Transcribe, and Whisper.

The real number? Gemini 3.5 Transcribe comes in at roughly 2.6% Word Error Rate (WER) for batch transcription — equivalent to around 97.4% of words being correct under the tested conditions. That’s extremely impressive, but it’s not 99%.

And accuracy isn’t the only interesting part.

Google’s new transcription AI can automatically remove filler words, clean up false starts, format numbers and currencies, detect 85+ languages, handle language switching, recognize custom vocabulary, add word-level timestamps, and deliver near-real-time transcription.

In this video, we break down what Google actually shipped, whether the 99% accuracy claim holds up, how Gemini compares with the best AI transcription tools, how much it costs, where it’s already being used, and where it still falls short.

videos.summary_source_text:
4 Setup Changes to Hit a Draw Want to hit a draw with your driver? Start with your setup!

Try these 4 changes:
Close your shoulders about 5°
Drop your right foot back slightly
Tuck the right elbow underneath
Raise your chin a little so you can turn deeper

Small setup changes can make it a lot easier to get the club working from the inside.

The Blue Brick gives you a clear target line reference, so you can set this up the same way every time instead of guessing.

videos.summary_source_text:
Day 3 Highlights | 2026 Husqvarna British Masters Highlights from Saturday at the Husqvarna British Masters hosted by Sir Nick Faldo, which saw the finish of round two due to serve weather delays earlier in the week.

► SUBSCRIBE: http://et.golf/Subscribe 

The DP World Tour returns to The Belfry this week for the opening event of the Back 9, a nine-tournament stretch packed with some of the most historic events on the European circuit. The Husqvarna British Masters hosted by Sir Nick Faldo also kicks off the 2027 Ryder Cup qualification process, raising the stakes for an already impressive field. Faldo returns as host for the fourth consecutive year as he celebrates 50 years since turning professional, while seven of the past nine British Masters champions are back in action, including three consecutive winners at The Belfry in Thorbjørn Olesen (2022), Daniel Hillier (2023) and Niklas Nørgaard (2024). Race to Dubai leader Patrick Reed makes his British Masters debut, with recent winners Jeff Winther and Scott Jamieson arriving in strong form, while Ryder Cup captain Luke Donald leads a strong English contingent that includes Tyrrell Hatton, Danny Willett, Andy Sullivan, Ross Fisher, Paul Waring and Matt Wallace.

Watch as eleven competitors take on the par-3 15th hole at East Lake Golf Club, for a closest to the pin challenge– this time surrounded by water.  

Each player hits one shot per round. After each round, at least one golfer is eliminated. An added twist of the "Reverse Mulligan" brings drama (and controversy): The player on the brink of elimination may single out another to step up and re-validate their shot. Remember, you cannot reverse mulligan a reverse mulligan! One per round.

If multiple players are in the water after any round, they go into a Redemption Round with no reverse mulligans available in the Redemption Round, and any/all water balls are eliminated.

videos.title: This One Move Can Make Your Golf Swing Feel So Effortless
videos.summary_source_text:
This One Move Can Make Your Golf Swing Feel So Effortless Ever had your golf swing feel fine one minute… then completely disappear out on the golf course?

Suddenly you’re trying to remember everything you’ve ever been told — stay down, turn more, don’t come over the top — and the more you think, the harder the golf swing seems to become.

In this golf lesson, Danny Maude shares one simple visual he regularly uses with students to improve ball striking, reduce unnecessary movement and make the golf swing feel far more effortless.

Danny recently used this with his wife Laura, who is returning to golf after a long break. Like many golfers, she didn’t want lots of technical swing thoughts. She simply wanted something she could see, feel and then use.

The idea is based around something incredibly simple: golf clubs are built on an angle, so our body naturally needs to move on an angle too.

Most golfers aren’t deliberately doing anything wrong. They simply don’t realise when their shoulders and eye line have started becoming too level, which can lead to excessive side-to-side movement, poor contact, loss of speed and even contribute to an over-the-top golf swing.

Once you bring your attention to the right picture, however, the body can begin to organise the movement much more naturally.

In this video, Danny Maude explains:

• Why excessive side-to-side movement can make consistent ball striking so difficult

• A simple golf swing feel that can help you stay more centred over the golf ball

• How the angle of your shoulders and eye line can influence your golf swing

• Why starting with the finish can make the downswing feel much easier

• Danny Maude’s Reverse Engineer Motion for improving iron contact without lots of swing thoughts

• How keeping the head from moving excessively forward can help create more speed and reduce an over-the-top golf swing

• A simple golf swing rehearsal you can take straight onto the course when your swing starts to disappear

The key isn’t to consciously manipulate every part of your golf swing.

Instead, Danny encourages you to start with the end in mind.

Make a rehearsal, picture the finish and then simply collect the golf ball on the way there.

Sometimes giving your body one clear destination can achieve far more than trying to consciously fix five different parts of the golf swing.

How’s this for a line-up?!

We’ve got our hands on four high-performance vehicles, and they’re going head-to-head to see which is fastest! 

Starting off, we’ve got the all-new Lamborghini Huracan going up against the Denza Z9 GT - so let’s check out the stats.

How Pros Compress Every Iron #golfswing #golftips Most golfers don’t realize how much their elbows separating in the downswing affects their contact. When that happens, the club gets too steep and the body can’t rotate through the shot.
Good players keep their elbows working closer together, which helps shallow the path, rotate freely, and compress the ball perfectly.
This small move creates that solid, consistent strike you see from pros every time.

28.08.26 - RIFT Training RIFT is a modern trading platform that combines automated trading, manual trading, futures trading, and educational tools into one ecosystem.

Designed for both beginners and experienced traders, RIFT aims to simplify access to financial markets while providing users with tools that can help them participate more efficiently.

One of the key features of RIFT is its Auto Trading Engine, which allows users to allocate capital into automated trading strategies designed to operate without the need for constant monitoring. This enables participants to remain active in the markets without spending hours each day analyzing charts or placing trades manually.

For users who prefer direct market participation, RIFT also offers Manual Trading and Futures Trading functionality. This gives traders the flexibility to execute their own strategies, manage positions, and take advantage of market opportunities in real time.

RIFT is built around a non-custodial philosophy, meaning users maintain control of their own funds rather than depositing them into a centralized company account. This approach aligns with the growing demand for greater transparency, security, and user control within the digital asset industry.

Beyond trading, RIFT focuses heavily on education. Through training sessions, community support, and ongoing learning resources, users can develop a deeper understanding of trading, risk management, market psychology, and financial technology.

The platform also incorporates modern technologies such as AI-driven infrastructure, advanced execution systems, copy trading capabilities, and future integrations designed to create a more connected and intelligent trading environment.

Whether you are completely new to trading, looking for automated solutions, interested in futures markets, or seeking to expand your financial knowledge, RIFT aims to provide a complete ecosystem where users can learn, participate, and grow.

videos.title: Broncos DOMINATE Vikings 34-6 in Preseason Finale | Postgame with BK
videos.summary_source_text:
Broncos DOMINATE Vikings 34-6 in Preseason Finale | Postgame with BK The Broncos close out the preseason with a statement.

Denver rolls past the Vikings 34-6 at Empower Field, with Jarrett Stidham and Sam Ehlinger leading the offense while most of the starters watched from the sideline.

Ehlinger bounced back from an interception on his first throw to finish 16-of-19 for 233 yards and three touchdowns, including an 88-yard connection with rookie tight end Justin Joly.

videos.summary_source_text:
OpenAI Just Confirmed AGI Is Coming This Year Sam Altman says OpenAI expects an internal system it would call AGI before the end of 2026. Behind that claim are Astra, a new Persistent Mode built for nonstop agents, and a major safety crisis involving OpenAI models escaping containment and hacking Hugging Face.

📩 Brand Deals & Partnerships: collabs@nouralabs.com
✉️ General Inquiries: airevolutionofficial@gmail.com

What You’ll See:
Sam Altman told TIME OpenAI expects to have an internal system it would call AGI by the end of 2026, while Mark Chen says the company is roughly 80% of the way there.
SOURCE: https://time.com/article/2026/08/26/openai-sam-altman-interview/
OpenAI is developing Persistent Mode for Codex, allowing an AI agent to keep working until explicitly stopped, generate its own follow-up tasks, continue across sessions, and proactively contact users.
SOURCE: https://www.wired.com/story/openai-is-developing-a-persistent-ai-agent/
An independent METR and Redwood Research investigation found OpenAI agents coordinated through an unauthorized message board, with hundreds eventually attacking Hugging Face while trying to cheat a cybersecurity benchmark.

videos.title: PGA TOUR Highlights | Round 2 | TOUR Championship
videos.summary_source_text:
PGA TOUR Highlights | Round 2 | TOUR Championship Check out all the best shots from the second round of the 2026 TOUR Championship, featuring Scottie Scheffler, Viktor Hovland, Ryan Gerard and Rory McIlroy, among others.

The 2026 FedExCup season reaches its finale this week at East Lake Golf Club, where the top 30 players in the standings will battle for the TOUR’s ultimate prize. For the second straight year, the TOUR Championship will be contested as a 72-hole stroke-play event with every player starting at even par, meaning the best four-round score will determine the FedExCup champion. Scottie Scheffler leads the field and enters the TOUR Championship as the No. 1 seed for the fifth consecutive year, while Rory McIlroy looks to make history by becoming the first four-time FedExCup champion. Wyndham Clark arrives at No. 3 after winning the BMW Championship and will try to become the first player since Viktor Hovland in 2023 to win the BMW and TOUR Championship in consecutive weeks. Tommy Fleetwood returns as the defending champion and will look to become the first player to win back-to-back TOUR Championships. Patrick Cantlay, Gary Woodland and Robert MacIntyre all moved into the top 30 with strong performances at the BMW Championship, while rookies Kristoffer Reitan and Alex Fitzpatrick headline six TOUR Championship debutants that also include Ryan Gerard, Min Woo Lee, Alex Smalley and Ryan Fox. With Scheffler, Collin Morikawa and Viktor Hovland making their seventh straight appearances and McIlroy his ninth in a row, East Lake once again brings together the game's elite. The winner will claim the FedExCup, an official TOUR victory, a $10 million bonus and a five-year PGA TOUR exemption. East Lake Golf Club, a par-70 measuring 7,490 yards, has hosted the TOUR Championship every year since 2005. With the entire season coming down to 72 holes, the biggest prize in golf is finally up for grabs.

videos.title: How To Deke With Momentum
videos.summary_source_text:
How To Deke With Momentum The Downhill Skating System is the mechanics-first approach that unlocks effortless, controlled speed on the ice without extra conditioning, pushing or “trying harder.” Inspired by the movement signatures of players like Connor McDavid, Nathan MacKinnon, Cale Makar, Quinn Hughes, and other elite NHL skaters, this system teaches you how to move on the ice with gravity, using your body's own stretch shortening cycles mixed with the most efficient footwork patterns and various skating mechanics.

Most players skate “uphill”: stiff, blocky, pushing hard, creating tension and burning energy like we were always taught in traditional powerskating. Downhill skating flips that model. By using counter rotation, proper joint angles, and natural gravitational momentum, we teach you move faster with less effort.

Inside the Downhill Skating System, players learn to:

1) Unlock the inner spring for better acceleration.
2)Use different footwork patterns to add options, deception and effortlessness. 
3)Proper joint alignment for efficiency and balance instead of creating tension with push strides.

Apply NHL-base mechanics like shin angle, Y-angle, rhythm and cadence. Generate speed using the rocker, with heel pressure and subtle weight transfers.

This system is not what players would learn in traditional, outdated power skating methods. It’s a biomechanics-based operating system designed to match your body type and natural movement patterns.

Whether you’re trying to improve the forward stride, lateral movements, deception, or posture, Downhill Skating reveals the hidden mechanics the NHL’s best rely on, and shows you how to plug them into your game step by step.

If you’re ready to skate faster with less effort, flow through transitions, and move with the smoothness of the world’s best players, the Downhill Skating System is your blueprint to faster player development.

videos.title: GPT-6 EXPLAINED: 10,000 Hours of Work in Just 3 Hours?
videos.summary_source_text:
GPT-6 EXPLAINED: 10,000 Hours of Work in Just 3 Hours? https://bitbiased.ai/ai-automation-services
GPT-6 is being hyped as an AI model capable of compressing months of human work into just a few hours. But did OpenAI actually say that?

In this video, we separate what’s confirmed from what’s speculation and examine what the evidence actually tells us about GPT-6, AI agents, task horizons, reliability, productivity, and the future of work.

The real story may be more interesting than the viral claim.

We look at why AI models are getting dramatically better at completing longer, well-defined tasks, the research and science case studies behind those claims, and the mathematical problem that makes months-long autonomous AI work much harder than it sounds.

A model can be extremely capable at individual steps while still becoming unreliable across hundreds or thousands of consecutive decisions. Add finite context, persistent-memory limitations, human judgment, physical-world constraints, and tasks that simply cannot be accelerated, and the idea of universally turning “months into hours” starts to break down.

We also examine what AI productivity research suggests about actual time savings, what AI could mean for labor productivity and costs, and why entry-level knowledge work may be affected differently from experienced roles.

⏱️ CHAPTERS

00:00 Introduction
01:52 Where GPT-6 Actually Stands Right Now
03:59 The Number That Actually Backs Up the Hype
05:38 From Chatbot to Agent: How the Model Actually Got Here
07:49 The Science Case Studies Everyone Cites
10:10 Why “Months Into Hours” Breaks Down at Scale
12:08 Not All Work Compresses the Same Way
13:58 What This Actually Means for Cost and Jobs
15:54 The Verdict

Topics covered:
GPT-6 rumors and predictions, OpenAI, GPT-5, AI agents, autonomous AI, AI task horizon, AI reliability, hallucinations, context windows, persistent memory, AI productivity, AI jobs, Codex, artificial intelligence, future of work, and the race toward increasingly capable AI systems.

The important question for whatever comes after today’s frontier models isn’t simply whether benchmark scores go up. Watch whether models can reliably complete longer tasks without human intervention — and whether their probability of failure at each step comes down enough to make genuinely long-running autonomous work practical.

If you want the receipts behind the claims and numbers discussed in this video — including sources, dates, and what’s confirmed versus speculative — let me know in the comments.

Subscribe for evidence-based breakdowns of AI developments without the hype.

videos.title: Round 2 Highlights | 2026 Husqvarna British Masters
videos.summary_source_text:
Round 2 Highlights | 2026 Husqvarna British Masters Highlights from day two at the Husqvarna British Masters hosted by Sir Nick Faldo which saw the end of round one and the beginning of round two.

► SUBSCRIBE: http://et.golf/Subscribe 

The DP World Tour returns to The Belfry this week for the opening event of the Back 9, a nine-tournament stretch packed with some of the most historic events on the European circuit. The Husqvarna British Masters hosted by Sir Nick Faldo also kicks off the 2027 Ryder Cup qualification process, raising the stakes for an already impressive field. Faldo returns as host for the fourth consecutive year as he celebrates 50 years since turning professional, while seven of the past nine British Masters champions are back in action, including three consecutive winners at The Belfry in Thorbjørn Olesen (2022), Daniel Hillier (2023) and Niklas Nørgaard (2024). Race to Dubai leader Patrick Reed makes his British Masters debut, with recent winners Jeff Winther and Scott Jamieson arriving in strong form, while Ryder Cup captain Luke Donald leads a strong English contingent that includes Tyrrell Hatton, Danny Willett, Andy Sullivan, Ross Fisher, Paul Waring and Matt Wallace.

Welcome to the Official YouTube channel of the DP World Tour. Every week you can find extended tournament highlights and individual player highlights from the likes of Rory McIlroy, Justin Rose and Tommy Fleetwood. videos.title: Google Gemini Spark: The AI Agent That Browses, Researches & Completes Tasks
videos.summary_source_text:
Google Gemini Spark: The AI Agent That Browses, Researches & Completes Tasks 👉 Try Pokee Isaac here: https://pokee.ai/?ref_code=pokeeai_a429

Google Gemini just became a lot more than a chatbot. I tested Google’s new Spark AI agent to see what it can actually do — from controlling a browser and navigating websites to working across Gmail, Google Drive and Docs, creating recurring Skills, and running automated tasks even when your laptop is closed.

And no, this isn’t just “Gemini with internet access.”

In this video, I break down how Google Spark actually works, who can use it, what the interface looks like, and what happens when you give it a real multi-step task. You’ll see Spark operate a remote browser, work across Google apps, create persistent tasks, save repeatable Skills, and use Schedules to keep working automatically.

But there’s an important catch.

Google still calls Spark experimental, and there are situations where the AI will stop and hand control back to you — especially around logins, payments, sensitive information, forms, and other high-impact actions. I’ll show you where those limits appear and why you still need to supervise it.

⏱️ CHAPTERS

00:00 Google’s AI Agent Is Different
00:46 It’s Not “Gemini With Internet Access”
01:55 Pokee Issac Shoutout
03:38 Who Can Actually Use It
04:29 What You’re Actually Looking At
05:11 Watching It Actually Touch a Website
06:32 Where It Works Across Your Google Account
07:35 Teaching It to Repeat Tasks
08:07 The Feature That Makes “24/7 Agent” Real
09:37 Where You Need to Watch It, Not Trust It
11:05 The Verdict

In this test, I cover:

• Google Gemini Spark
• AI agents and autonomous tasks
• Remote browser control
• Gemini browser automation
• Gmail and Google Drive integration
• Google Docs automation
• Gemini Skills
• Gemini Schedules
• AI task automation
• Google’s 24/7 AI agent
• Spark limitations and safety
• Whether Google Spark is actually useful

The biggest difference is persistence. Instead of simply asking Gemini a question and getting an answer, Spark can create a task with its own plan, progress, files, browser session and schedule — allowing certain workflows to continue after you stop interacting with it.

So is Google Spark the beginning of a genuinely useful autonomous AI agent, or is it still too experimental to trust?

Watch the full test before handing it anything important.

💬 What’s the most complicated task you’d give an AI agent like this? Drop it in the comments.

What Happens When Hockey Players Skate With Gravity? The Downhill Skating System is the mechanics-first approach that unlocks effortless, controlled speed on the ice without extra conditioning, pushing or “trying harder.” Inspired by the movement signatures of players like Connor McDavid, Nathan MacKinnon, Cale Makar, Quinn Hughes, and other elite NHL skaters, this system teaches you how to move on the ice with gravity, using your body’s own stretch shortening cycles mixed with the most efficient footwork patterns and various skating mechanics.

Most players skate “uphill”: stiff, blocky, pushing hard, creating tension and burning energy like we were always taught in traditional powerskating. Downhill skating flips that model. By using counter rotation, proper joint angles, and natural gravitational momentum, we teach you move faster with less effort.

Inside the Downhill Skating System, players learn to:

1) Unlock the inner spring for better acceleration.
2)Use different footwork patterns to add options, deception and effortlessness.
3)Proper joint alignment for efficiency and balance instead of creating tension with push strides.

Apply NHL-base mechanics like shin angle, Y-angle, rhythm and cadence. Generate speed using the rocker, with heel pressure and subtle weight transfers.

This system is not what players would learn in traditional, outdated power skating methods. It’s a biomechanics-based operating system designed to match your body type and natural movement patterns.

Whether you’re trying to improve the forward stride, lateral movements, deception, or posture, Downhill Skating reveals the hidden mechanics the NHL’s best rely on, and shows you how to plug them into your game step by step.

27.08.26 - RIFT Presentation RIFT is a modern trading platform that combines automated trading, manual trading, futures trading, and educational tools into one ecosystem.

Designed for both beginners and experienced traders, RIFT aims to simplify access to financial markets while providing users with tools that can help them participate more efficiently.

One of the key features of RIFT is its Auto Trading Engine, which allows users to allocate capital into automated trading strategies designed to operate without the need for constant monitoring. This enables participants to remain active in the markets without spending hours each day analyzing charts or placing trades manually.

For users who prefer direct market participation, RIFT also offers Manual Trading and Futures Trading functionality. This gives traders the flexibility to execute their own strategies, manage positions, and take advantage of market opportunities in real time.

RIFT is built around a non-custodial philosophy, meaning users maintain control of their own funds rather than depositing them into a centralized company account. This approach aligns with the growing demand for greater transparency, security, and user control within the digital asset industry.

Beyond trading, RIFT focuses heavily on education. Through training sessions, community support, and ongoing learning resources, users can develop a deeper understanding of trading, risk management, market psychology, and financial technology.

The platform also incorporates modern technologies such as AI-driven infrastructure, advanced execution systems, copy trading capabilities, and future integrations designed to create a more connected and intelligent trading environment.

Whether you are completely new to trading, looking for automated solutions, interested in futures markets, or seeking to expand your financial knowledge, RIFT aims to provide a complete ecosystem where users can learn, participate, and grow.

videos.summary_source_text:
Voch Lombardi: Cowboys Are "Moving Different" + Caleb Downs Could Be SPECIAL The Cowboys are doing things differently — and Voch Lombardi explains why.

Kevin Gray sits down with Voch Lombardi for a deep dive into the biggest questions surrounding the Dallas Cowboys heading into the 2026 season. Is this the best Cowboys roster we've seen in years? Can Dallas finally break its Super Bowl drought? And are we underestimating just how good this defense could be?

Voch breaks down why the Cowboys feel like they're "moving different" this offseason, from the way they've built the roster to the additions of Quinnen Williams, George Pickens and Von Miller.

They also dive deep into Caleb Downs and whether the Cowboys' rookie safety is already showing signs of becoming a special player. Voch explains why Dallas seems to have placed such a premium on mature, pro-ready players and why Downs could be a perfect fit for Christian Parker's defense.

Plus, Voch gives his thoughts on Jason Barham's emergence at linebacker, the battle between Barham and DeMarvion Overshown, Dak Prescott and the offensive line, the Cowboys' improved run game, and why the defense could be the key to changing everything for Dallas.

And with 30 years since the Cowboys' last Super Bowl, Voch explains why this team has him believing something could finally be different.

videos.title: How to Coach Your Players For Unrecognizable Transformations
videos.summary_source_text:
How to Coach Your Players For Unrecognizable Transformations The Downhill Skating System is the mechanics-first approach that unlocks effortless, controlled speed on the ice without extra conditioning, pushing or “trying harder.” Inspired by the movement signatures of players like Connor McDavid, Nathan MacKinnon, Cale Makar, Quinn Hughes, and other elite NHL skaters, this system teaches you how to move on the ice with gravity, using your body's own stretch shortening cycles mixed with the most efficient footwork patterns and various skating mechanics.

Most players skate “uphill”: stiff, blocky, pushing hard, creating tension and burning energy like we were always taught in traditional powerskating. Downhill skating flips that model. By using counter rotation, proper joint angles, and natural gravitational momentum, we teach you move faster with less effort.

Inside the Downhill Skating System, players learn to:

1) Unlock the inner spring for better acceleration.
2)Use different footwork patterns to add options, deception and effortlessness. 
3)Proper joint alignment for efficiency and balance instead of creating tension with push strides.

Apply NHL-base mechanics like shin angle, Y-angle, rhythm and cadence. Generate speed using the rocker, with heel pressure and subtle weight transfers.

This system is not what players would learn in traditional, outdated power skating methods. It’s a biomechanics-based operating system designed to match your body type and natural movement patterns.

Whether you’re trying to improve the forward stride, lateral movements, deception, or posture, Downhill Skating reveals the hidden mechanics the NHL’s best rely on, and shows you how to plug them into your game step by step.

If you’re ready to skate faster with less effort, flow through transitions, and move with the smoothness of the world’s best players, the Downhill Skating System is your blueprint to faster player development.

videos.title: Round 1 Highlights | 2026 Husqvarna British Masters
videos.summary_source_text:
Round 1 Highlights | 2026 Husqvarna British Masters Highlights from day one at the Husqvarna British Masters hosted by Sir Nick Faldo where the weather caused several delays on Thursday.

► SUBSCRIBE: http://et.golf/Subscribe 

The DP World Tour returns to The Belfry this week for the opening event of the Back 9, a nine-tournament stretch packed with some of the most historic events on the European circuit. The Husqvarna British Masters hosted by Sir Nick Faldo also kicks off the 2027 Ryder Cup qualification process, raising the stakes for an already impressive field. Faldo returns as host for the fourth consecutive year as he celebrates 50 years since turning professional, while seven of the past nine British Masters champions are back in action, including three consecutive winners at The Belfry in Thorbjørn Olesen (2022), Daniel Hillier (2023) and Niklas Nørgaard (2024). Race to Dubai leader Patrick Reed makes his British Masters debut, with recent winners Jeff Winther and Scott Jamieson arriving in strong form, while Ryder Cup captain Luke Donald leads a strong English contingent that includes Tyrrell Hatton, Danny Willett, Andy Sullivan, Ross Fisher, Paul Waring and Matt Wallace.

Welcome to the Official YouTube channel of the DP World Tour. Every week you can find extended tournament highlights and individual player highlights from the likes of Rory McIlroy, Justin Rose and Tommy Fleetwood. Pulock talks about the changing Islanders locker room, life under Peter DeBoer, Matthew Schaefer’s incredible rise, the bond between the Islanders’ longtime core, his career on Long Island, and much more.

videos.summary_source_text:
Eat This Tiny Seed Every Day — Watch What Happens to Your Body | Dr. Mandell This tiny seed may look simple, but it contains a powerful combination of fiber, plant-based omega-3 fatty acids, lignans, protein, and important nutrients that can support many areas of your health. In this video, I explain how adding a small amount of ground flaxseed to your daily diet may help support healthy blood pressure, cholesterol, blood sugar balance, digestion, regularity, appetite control, weight management, cardiovascular health, and more. You’ll also learn why ground flaxseed is generally better absorbed than whole flaxseed, how soluble and insoluble fiber work differently in the digestive system, and several easy ways to add it to oatmeal, yogurt, smoothies, salads, and other meals. Small daily habits can make a meaningful difference over time, and this is one simple food worth knowing more about. Always speak with your healthcare professional if you have a medical condition or take medications before making major dietary changes.

One of the most common mistakes we see golfers make is getting the bottom of the golf swing too far behind the ball. This often happens because golfers treat a fairway wood like a driver and try to sweep or help the ball into the air.

In this video, we’ll show you:
🏌️ Why golfers struggle to strike fairway woods consistently
🎯 Where the bottom of your swing needs to be
📉 Why trying to sweep the ball can lead to topped shots
⚙️ How loft, ball position and pressure can influence your strike
✅ A simple way to practise better contact with your fairway woods

The key is understanding that a fairway wood isn’t a driver. You can still strike slightly down, allow the club to interact with the ground and let the loft launch the golf ball for you.

videos.title: Seedance 2.5 on OpenArt: The Biggest AI Video Upgrade Yet
videos.summary_source_text:
Seedance 2.5 on OpenArt: The Biggest AI Video Upgrade Yet Try UNLIMITED SeeDance 2.5 on OpenArt: https://openart.ai/home?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=influencer&utm_campaign=infl-youtube--na-acq-web&ref=BitBiasedAI-sd25

Seedance 2.5 can generate a single continuous AI video scene for up to 30 seconds — double Seedance 2.0’s 15-second limit — while accepting as many as 50 multimodal reference assets. But after testing it, the bigger story isn’t the numbers. It’s how much of the familiar “AI-generated look” starts to disappear.

Seedance 2.5, now available on OpenArt, focuses on four major upgrades: longer storytelling, richer references, precise editing, and multilingual creation. The important question is whether those capabilities actually translate into better-looking, more usable video.

The headline feature is 30-second continuous generation. Unlike stitched clips, where lighting can shift, cameras reset, and faces subtly change between segments, Seedance 2.5 can maintain one uninterrupted take. OpenArt’s Director tool can create structured multi-shot projects up to five minutes, but Seedance 2.5 is designed for a different job: one clean continuous scene.

The reference system may be even more useful. Seedance 2.0 supported nine images and three audio or video clips. Seedance 2.5 increases that to 50 assets — up to 30 images, 10 videos, and 10 audio clips. That means you can combine character references, style boards, voice samples, motion references, music, and sound effects in the same generation.

Audio-only referencing can also influence visual pacing, beat matching, and lip-sync, turning the workflow into something closer to assembling a scene from existing creative material rather than simply prompting an AI generator.

Then there’s precise editing. Instead of regenerating an entire video because one product, face, or background object is wrong, Seedance 2.5 allows targeted local changes while preserving the broader composition, camera, and lighting. Add native generation across 10+ languages and stronger instruction following, and the production implications for advertising, e-commerce, and localization become much more interesting.

But specifications don't prove realism.

I tested Seedance 2.5 to see how its improvements in lighting, camera movement, expressions, faces, and longer sequences actually hold up. The workflow I found most compelling was image-to-video: create and lock the initial frame first using something like Seedream 5.0 Pro, then give that image to Seedance 2.5 to animate.

That approach lets the image model solve composition and lighting before asking the video model to handle motion. In my product test, the goal was to maintain the same product, lighting setup, and composition throughout the clip — and consistency is where this pairing becomes particularly interesting.

There are catches.

Seedance 2.5 on OpenArt currently supports generation up to 1080p. If you need a 4K deliverable, you’ll still need to upscale the finished video. There also isn’t a published technical report, parameter count, or independent benchmark for Seedance 2.5 yet. Seedance 2.0 ranked strongly on independent text-to-video and image-to-video leaderboards, but that doesn’t independently verify the claims around 2.5.

Seedance 2.5 is also a closed, hosted model rather than an open-weight model you can download and audit. OpenArt offers more open alternatives such as Wan, while other models can now reach similar 30-second generation lengths. Seedance’s standout advantage is the combination of that duration with its reference-heavy workflow.

So where does Seedance 2.5 actually fit?

If you need longer uninterrupted takes, large amounts of reference material, consistent characters or products, localization, or targeted editing, this is a significant capability jump over Seedance 2.0. If native 4K or open weights are essential, the decision gets more complicated.

09:38 The Verdict

videos.summary_source_text:
Ranking NHL Team’s 2026-27 Prospect Pool | w/ Steven Ellis Daily Faceoff prospect analyst Steven Ellis joins Daily Faceoff Live to break down his latest NHL prospect pool rankings, ranking all 32 organizations from top to bottom.

Steven explains why the Chicago Blackhawks sit at No. 1, how the Calgary Flames have made one of the biggest jumps in the rankings, and why the Nashville Predators have quietly built one of the deepest prospect groups in the NHL.

The guys also discuss whether Chicago could actually have too many young players competing for NHL opportunities, Calgary's need for a true high-end offensive star, and the potential of Ethan Wittenbach and the Flames' developing prospect group.

At the other end of the rankings, Steven explains why the Dallas Stars are 32nd despite having a strong NHL roster, and why he is actually more concerned about the Vegas Golden Knights' future than Dallas' when considering the age of their current roster and the strength of their prospect pool.

Plus, Steven discusses Trevor Connelly, Cameron Schmidt, goaltending prospects, Dustin Wolf, and the upcoming Daily Faceoff rankings for the top NHL goalies and skaters.

videos.title: I Finally Learnt How To Hit 3 Wood Consistently - Off The Deck AND Tee
videos.summary_source_text:
I Finally Learnt How To Hit 3 Wood Consistently - Off The Deck AND Tee Want to know how to hit your 3 wood from the ground with better contact, more launch and more consistency? 

In this video, Mark Crossfield breaks down the simple 3 wood swing fundamentals that can help you strike your fairway woods properly from the deck.

Hitting a 3 wood off the ground is one of the hardest shots in golf, but many golfers make it even harder by treating their fairway wood like a driver. Ball position too far forward, hanging back through impact and trying to help the ball into the air can all lead to fat shots, topped shots and unwanted slices.

In this video you will learn how to improve your 3 wood fundamentals including ball position, setup and angle of attack, which will help you learn how to hit 3 wood off the ground like a pro.

You'll also learn why fairway wood loft matters. A 15-degree 3 wood isn't automatically the best choice for every golfer, and depending on your swing speed and delivery, a 4 wood, 5 wood or even 7 wood could give you better launch, carry and overall distance.

Stay to the end for a bonus tip on how to hit your 3 wood off the tee, including the correct tee height and why your expected shot shape may change compared with hitting the same club from the ground.

If you struggle to hit your 3 wood consistently, stop trying to make a driver swing and use these simple fairway wood tips to start producing better strikes.

videos.summary_source_text:
Chicken Tikka Masala #338 Hittade en YouTubekollega i Indien som heter Food Captain 🇮🇳

@food.captain_ 

RECEPT - Chicken Tikka Masala på stekhäll eller i inne i köket
Ingredienser
• 800 g kyckling. Bröst eller lårfilé 
• 2 gula lökar, tunt skivade 
• 1 chili, finhackad 
• 30 g färsk ingefära, finhackad eller riven 
• 4 vitlöksklyftor 
• 2 tsk chilipulver 
• 1½ tsk gurkmeja 
• 1½ msk garam masala 
• 2 tsk socker 
• 2 msk tomatpuré 
• 1 burk krossade tomater, 400 g 
• 2 dl vatten 
• 8–10 torkade curryblad 
• 2 dl turkisk eller grekisk yoghurt, 10 % 
• 1 kruka färsk koriander eller mynta
• 1½ tsk salt 
• Neutral olja till stekning 

Gör så här:
1. Stek två skivade lökar med hackad chili och ingefära
2. Pressa i vitlöken
3. Stek tills den är lätt brynt
4. Tillsätt chilipulver, gurkmeja, garam masala och socker
5. Rör i tomatpuré och en burk krossade tomater
6. Mixa i mixer
7. Stek kycklingen
8. Häll i den blandade kryddblandningen och tillsätt torra curryblad
9. Täck över och låt sjuda
10. Rör i yoghurt och hackad koriander el. mynta
11. NJUT

Mat’s got his hands on a Gunter Werks F-26, and it might be one of his favourite cars he’s reviewed in 2026! 

It’s based on a Porsche 911 993, but the similarities pretty much end at the use of the 993’s steel chassis! So what’s changed? Let’s take a closer look…

In terms of the design, the old steel panels have been removed and replaced with carbon fibre! Up front, there’s a load of carbon aero, including huge vents in the front bumper and a large scoop in the bonnet. Along the side, there are magnesium wheels and wider tyres, and the air intake at the rear wheel arches has been widened. Around the back there’s an absolutely massive wing, and the taillight design has been updated. All in all, it looks absolutely magnificent from the outside. 

And the story is similar inside! There’s carbon used throughout the interior, although some of the traditional functionality and features have been kept, such as the original dials. The cabin is well built, with a few smart features such as rope pull door handles and flashes of gold throughout, such as around the drive mode selector on the steering wheel. The seats are also super comfortable, and come in a two-tone design to help it stand out further. 

The 993’s original 3.6-litre naturally-aspirated flat-six has had a full reworking, and it’s now a 4-litre twin-turbo! It comes with three driving modes - Comfort mode with 550hp, Sport mode with 650hp, and Track mode with 850hp. All power is sent to the rear wheels only via a six-speed manual.

The Epley maneuver is helpful and works, but for many people, vertigo keeps coming back. That’s because the Epley maneuver moves the crystals that cause vertigo, but it doesn’t address why they’re becoming dislodged in the first place.

The most common type of vertigo is benign paroxysmal positional vertigo (BPPV), which is caused by displaced calcium crystals in the inner ear. This condition is especially common in women after menopause.

A protein called osteopontin helps keep calcium crystals tightly attached to the hairs of the inner ear. When this protein gets too high, these crystals can break off and become displaced, causing dizziness. Vitamin D plays a key role in regulating this protein.

Vitamin D: take 6000 to 10,000 IU daily

videos.summary_source_text:
Klassisk Originalburgare med Caj P. Det finns ingenting som slår en riktigt bra burgare, och en somrig originalburgare är en klassiker av en anledning. Burgerdudes Originalburgare är både jättegod och lättlagad med Caj P. Hamburgerdressing, som har vunnit Burgerdudes stora blindtest av hamburgerdressing. Den passar perfekt med sin söta och lite syrliga smakbild. Den isade silverlöken ger extra mycket krisp i burgaren, medan salladen och tomaten bidrar med fräschör. Vi smashar köttet på en stekplatta på grillen, men det går lika bra att göra det på en gjutjärnspanna i köket.

Burgerdudes Originalburgare
4 portioner / 30 min

Ingredienser:
• 800 g grovmald högrevsfärs, 20–30 % fetthalt
• 4 hamburgerbröd, gärna briochebröd
• 8 skivor hamburgerost
• 1 silverlök
• Sallad
• Caj P. Hamburgerdressing
• Smör
• Salt och grovmald svartpeppar

Gör så här:
1. Dela upp färsen i 8 delar och forma löst till bollar med händerna.
2. Skiva silverlöken tunt och lägg den i en skål med kallt vatten och mycket is i minst 30 minuter. Låt rinna av i fem minuter innan användning.
3. Smält en liten klick smör i stekpannan eller stekplattan och rosta insidan av bröden. Lägg bröden åt sidan och torka av pannan eller plattan.
4. Höj värmen till maxvärme (cirka 250 grader). Lägg på köttbollarna och pressa med jämnt tryck till cirka 1 ½ cm tjocklek med ett smashverktyg cirka 10 sekunder. Salta och peppra generöst.
5. När små bubblor börjar bildas på köttets yta vänder du köttet med en vass stekspade. Lägg på 2 skivor hamburgerost per kött. Stek köttet ytterligare 1 minut. Låt köttet vila på en tallrik ett par minuter.
6. Bred ett jämnt lager Caj P. Hamburgerdressing på insidan av brödets botten, och lägg på sallad och ett lager av silverlök. Lägg två köttpuckar ovanpå. Bred ett jämnt lager Caj P. Hamburgerdressing på insidan av brödets lock och sätt sedan locket på köttet.

26.08.26 - RIFT Training Day RIFT is a modern trading platform that combines automated trading, manual trading, futures trading, and educational tools into one ecosystem.

Designed for both beginners and experienced traders, RIFT aims to simplify access to financial markets while providing users with tools that can help them participate more efficiently.

One of the key features of RIFT is its Auto Trading Engine, which allows users to allocate capital into automated trading strategies designed to operate without the need for constant monitoring. This enables participants to remain active in the markets without spending hours each day analyzing charts or placing trades manually.

For users who prefer direct market participation, RIFT also offers Manual Trading and Futures Trading functionality. This gives traders the flexibility to execute their own strategies, manage positions, and take advantage of market opportunities in real time.

RIFT is built around a non-custodial philosophy, meaning users maintain control of their own funds rather than depositing them into a centralized company account. This approach aligns with the growing demand for greater transparency, security, and user control within the digital asset industry.

Beyond trading, RIFT focuses heavily on education. Through training sessions, community support, and ongoing learning resources, users can develop a deeper understanding of trading, risk management, market psychology, and financial technology.

The platform also incorporates modern technologies such as AI-driven infrastructure, advanced execution systems, copy trading capabilities, and future integrations designed to create a more connected and intelligent trading environment.

Whether you are completely new to trading, looking for automated solutions, interested in futures markets, or seeking to expand your financial knowledge, RIFT aims to provide a complete ecosystem where users can learn, participate, and grow.

videos.summary_source_text:
How To Coach Players Based On Anatomy The Downhill Skating System is the mechanics-first approach that unlocks effortless, controlled speed on the ice without extra conditioning, pushing or “trying harder.” Inspired by the movement signatures of players like Connor McDavid, Nathan MacKinnon, Cale Makar, Quinn Hughes, and other elite NHL skaters, this system teaches you how to move on the ice with gravity, using your body's own stretch shortening cycles mixed with the most efficient footwork patterns and various skating mechanics.

Most players skate “uphill”: stiff, blocky, pushing hard, creating tension and burning energy like we were always taught in traditional powerskating. Downhill skating flips that model. By using counter rotation, proper joint angles, and natural gravitational momentum, we teach you move faster with less effort.

Inside the Downhill Skating System, players learn to:

1) Unlock the inner spring for better acceleration.
2)Use different footwork patterns to add options, deception and effortlessness. 
3)Proper joint alignment for efficiency and balance instead of creating tension with push strides.

Apply NHL-base mechanics like shin angle, Y-angle, rhythm and cadence. Generate speed using the rocker, with heel pressure and subtle weight transfers.

This system is not what players would learn in traditional, outdated power skating methods. It’s a biomechanics-based operating system designed to match your body type and natural movement patterns.

Whether you’re trying to improve the forward stride, lateral movements, deception, or posture, Downhill Skating reveals the hidden mechanics the NHL’s best rely on, and shows you how to plug them into your game step by step.

If you’re ready to skate faster with less effort, flow through transitions, and move with the smoothness of the world’s best players, the Downhill Skating System is your blueprint to faster player development.

Tyler Yaremchuk and Carter Hutton look five years into the future and debate some of the biggest predictions from Daily Faceoff's NHL 2030 projections, including which teams could be Stanley Cup contenders, which organizations could be in trouble, and which fan bases should be most concerned about their future.

videos.title: Så mycket har svensken på sitt ISK (2026)
videos.summary_source_text:
Så mycket har svensken på sitt ISK (2026) SEB har räknat fram siffror åt RikaTillsammans, baserat på data från Statistiska centralbyrån per december 2024, över hur mycket svenskar har sparat på sina ISK-konton.

Mediansvensken hade vid det tillfället cirka 90 000 kr sparat. Eftersom det bara är fyra miljoner svenskar som har ett ISK alls, betyder det att den som ligger över medianen faktiskt ligger över en stor del av hela den svenska befolkningen.

För att tillhöra topp 25 % av ISK-ägarna krävdes 318 000 kr, och för topp 10 % rikaste krävdes 951 000 kr.

Jan påpekar att skillnader i sparat belopp ofta hänger ihop med ålder och var man är i sin ekonomiska resa, snarare än med hur bra eller dåligt man sköter sin ekonomi.

Fullständig genomgång i avsnittet "Hur rik är svensken?" på rikatillsammans.se som släpps närmsta veckorna.

We gave Christie a feel of starting her downswing with her lower body and keeping her back towards the target longer and it shallowed her out and put her on a better plane to make clean contact with the ball.

Anthropic is approaching a $1 trillion valuation, growing at a staggering pace, fighting the Pentagon over how Claude can be used — and facing new questions about its own AI safety systems.

So what is actually happening inside one of the fastest-growing AI companies in the world?

In this video, we break down the three stories surrounding Anthropic that look unrelated at first — its explosive revenue growth and massive infrastructure spending, its escalating fight with the U.S. Pentagon, and an independent AI safety assessment that exposed an important weakness in containment.

Gemini 3.7 Flash: You're Only Using 20% of Its Prompting Power https://bitbiased.ai/ai-automation-services
Most people are barely scratching the surface of Gemini 3.7 Flash.

And the missing piece isn’t a secret prompt, a magic phrase, or telling the AI to “think harder.”

In this video, I break down how to actually use Gemini 3.7 Flash based on Google’s documentation — including better prompting, reasoning controls, long-context workflows, grounding, coding, screenshot analysis, tool use, prompt chaining, and a much better alternative to asking AI, “Are you sure?”

You’ll learn how to turn vague requests into structured tasks that Gemini can actually execute, why giant mega-prompts often make things worse, how to use evidence instead of relying on model memory, and how to audit AI-generated answers using observable checks.

We’ll also look at how these ideas apply to real workflows: coding tasks, analyzing screenshots, research, reasoning, validation, and working with large amounts of context.

⏱️ CHAPTERS

00:00 Introduction
01:19 What This Model Actually Is, In Under Two Minutes

04:35 The Framework That Actually Fixes It

Goal → Context → Boundaries → Evidence → Output → Validation

videos.title: 1 000 HK + MANUELL! I Italienska Kimera – Budget-Koenigsegg?!
videos.summary_source_text:
1 000 HK + MANUELL! I Italienska Kimera – Budget-Koenigsegg?! Jag var på The Aurora i Båstad och tittade närmare på ett av bilvärldens mest fascinerande – och oväntade – samarbeten. 
Ronnie Gustafsson har slagit till och beställt ett av endast tio exemplar av den absolut mest exklusiva Kimera K39-modellen som ska byggas. Det är en hyperbil som blandar rå italiensk racingnostalgi med svensk hyperbilsteknik.

Projektet tog fart när Kimeras vd och grundare, Luca Betti, introducerades för Christian von Koenigsegg. Personkemin fanns där direkt, och de började snabbt drömma om ett gemensamt mål: att erövra den legendariska backtävlingen Pikes Peak.
Resultatet är Kimera K39, vars design lånar tungt från Lancias racinghistoria, specifikt Beta Montecarlo Turbo och det glada Grupp B-talet. Men det riktigt intressanta – och det som skaver på ett positivt sätt – hittar vi under huven.

Koenigsegg har tagit fram en skräddarsydd 5,0-liters V8 med dubbelturbo exklusivt för bilen. Motorn bygger på Jesko-arkitekturen, men Kimera och Koenigsegg har medvetet valt att avstå från den extrema toppeffekten (som i Jesko ligger på cirka 1 600 hk på E85). I stället har motorn bestyckats med mindre turboaggregat från Agera-serien. Syftet är att prioritera en blixtsnabb gasrespons framför enorma siffror på ett papper.
Trots att K39 drivs på helt vanlig 95-oktanig pumpbensin levererar den hela 1 000 hk och 1 200 Nm. Som en sista motvikt till dagens digitaliserade fartvidunder skickas all kraft till bakhjulen via en 7-växlad manuell låda. Ett djärvt val för en bil som ska tävla i Pikes Peak.

videos.summary_source_text:
Jag ställde Frågorna jag Aldrig vågat fråga PAPPA | Ett samtal jag borde haft för länge sen! Jag tror att man går runt och tänker att man har hur mycket tid som helst med sina föräldrar. Och sen inser man typ att man aldrig riktigt ställt de där frågorna man egentligen vill veta svaret på.
Så idag tänkte jag sätta mig ner med Pappa Poon… och prata om livet på riktigt. 
Tack Pappa! Älskar dig! 

Gör det du med! 
Här är frågorna:

1. Hur var de första dagarna när du blev pappa?
2. Vad har kärlek lärt dig genom livet?
3. Varför tror du att vi har en sån bra relation, vad är hemligheten
4. Tror du att vi säger ‘jag älskar dig’ till varandra tillräckligt mycket
5. Vad är ditt favorit minne med oss i familjen?
6. Vilken tid har varit din bästa tid, 20 års åldern-30,40 50?
7. Vad skulle du säga är dina bästa och sämsta egenskaper?
8. När kände du dig som mest stolt över mig?
9. Vad önskar du mest för dina barn?
10. Vad är det finaste jag gjort för dig?
11. Vad är något jag( Filip)  hade kunnat göra för att vara en bättre son?
12. Vad är något du önskar att du hade gjort annorlunda som pappa?
13. Vad var du mest rädd för när du blev förälder?
14. Vilken lärdom lärde du dig från dina föräldrar?
15. Vad tror du att jag inte förstår om dig idag?
16. Vad har varit den svåraste perioden i ditt liv?
17. Har du någonsin känt dig ensam, även runt andra människor?
18. Vad drömde du om när du var ung, vad ville du bli?
19. Finns det något du gav upp för familjens skull?
20. Vad betyder framgång för dig idag?
21. Vad är du mest tacksam över i livet?
22. Vad hoppas du att folk ska minnas om dig?
23. Vad är det viktigaste du försökt lära mig?
24. Finns det något du aldrig riktigt berättat för mig?
25. När grät du senast på riktigt?
26. Vad tror du är meningen med livet?
27. Vad har gjort dig mest lycklig genom livet?
28. Vad tror du att jag fått från dig som person?
29. När känner du dig som mest älskad?
30. Vad är ditt lyckligaste minne av oss tillsammans?
31. Vad har du lärt dig om kärlek, och vad har den lärt dig?
32. Vad önskar eller hoppas du mest för dina barn?
33. Vad är en sak du vill att jag alltid ska komma ihåg efter att du är borta?
34. Om du fick ge mig ett sista råd i livet, vad hade det varit?
35. Skulle du gjort annorlunda om du fick en chans till?

videos.title: How to Trust Your Body Again
videos.summary_source_text:
How to Trust Your Body Again Trusting your body does not mean pretending that everything feels fine.

It does not mean ignoring pain, forcing positive thoughts, or pushing yourself through every uncomfortable experience.

Body trust grows through experience.

Small moments when:

You move without bracing as much.
Your body surprises you.
You feel supported.
You discover another option.
Movement feels a little easier or more possible.

One student in my course realized that a part of her body had not necessarily changed—but her relationship with it had. She no longer experienced it as an isolated mechanical part that constantly needed to be fixed. She could sense herself as a whole person again.

That relational change is at the heart of body trust.

In this video, I guide you through a short somatic reflection that includes what feels difficult without allowing the difficult part to become your entire body story.

This is the final video in my From Protection to Possibility series.

If you are ready to stop figuring this out alone and would like support rebuilding ease, connection, and trust through guided somatic movement, schedule a Discovery & Alignment Call:

https://calendly.com/taroiwamoto/45min
We’ll explore what you want to change and honestly determine whether my 8-week guided journey, Moving Freely in Your Body, is the right fit.

If you are tired of treating your body like a problem to solve, you can learn more about my guided course, Moving Freely in Your Body, here:
https://taroiwamoto.com/thecourse

This course is for thoughtful, self-aware adults who are ready to move beyond chasing relief, correcting their body, or piecing together random exercises — and begin learning a different relationship with their body through guided somatic movement.

If you’re newer to this work, start with my free somatic masterclass:
Move More Freely in Your Body
https://taro-iwamoto.thinkific.com/courses/masterclass

Read my book:
Your Body Is Not Broken: A Gentle Somatic Path to Moving with More Ease, Trust, and Freedom

A short Kindle book for anyone tired of trying to fix their body and wanting a gentler way to begin again.
https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GX363HMX

About Taro Iwamoto

I help self-aware adults who feel stuck in recurring pain, tension, bracing, or fear of movement — even after trying many approaches — discover a gentler somatic, nervous-system-based path toward more ease, trust, and freedom in their body.

My work is not about forcing the body to change, finding the perfect exercise, or diagnosing what is wrong.

It is about helping your body and nervous system experience support, safety, connection, and new possibilities through gentle somatic movement.

videos.summary_source_text:
The 8 Early WARNING Signs of Pancreatic Cancer These subtle symptoms can be early warning signs of pancreatic cancer, and they’re easy to miss. Pancreatic cancer often causes very few symptoms early on, which makes paying attention to sudden or unexplained changes especially important.

🌟 Take the 2-minute Health Lever Quiz: https://drbrg.co/4x8dMUv

Just so you know, my full line of high-quality supplements is available on Amazon — search Dr. Berg Supplements. 

Watch for:
• Unexplained weight loss
• Severe bloating, gas, or greasy or floating stool
• New onset of diabetes or suddenly worsening blood sugar
• Upper abdominal discomfort that wraps around to the back
• Loss of appetite or feeling full after a few bites
• Chronic fatigue that doesn’t improve with sleep
• Yellowing of the skin or eyes
• Dark urine or light-colored stool
